title: "Glossary"
bibliography: references.bib
---

This page provides the glossary of key terms used in this preregistration tutorial.

+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Term                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

| Questionable Research Practices (QRPs) | Questionable research practices (QRPs) are a set of *intentional* or *unintentional* behaviors where researchers distort study findings. Examples include p-hacking and HARKing [@parsons2022]                                                                                                                                                                             |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Hypothesis                             | A hypothesis is an unproven statement relating the connection between variables.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|                                        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                        | ####                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Preregistration                        | An uneditable time-stamped document that outlines a study plan including research questions/hypotheses, research design, data analysis *before* data collection and analysis. A study preregistration is then uploaded onto a verified repository so that it can be publicly shared with others (possibly after an embargo period) [@nosek2018; @parsons2022]              |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Registered report                      | A publishing format where a study undergoes *two stages* of peer review: *stage 1:* introduction and methods in advance of data collection/analysis, where high quality manuscipts are in-princple accepted for publication. After data collection, manuscripts containing full study findings including results/discussion are re-reviewed at *stage 2* [@parsons2022].   |
+----------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
